scope: Proposition 12.3 (Central determinant formula) of the manuscript “Goldfeld's analytic density conjecture and the 2-converse for elliptic curves” (preprints/Goldfelds-analytic-density-conjecture-and-the-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 006 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c417858c9fe566da), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 91. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant Cloc, depending only on the fixed curve and local classes, with the following property. Suppose c2(E(hx)) = 0. If L(E(hx), 1) = 0, then ux(0) = 0; if L(E(hx), 1) ̸= 0, then v2(ux(0)) − D(hx) ≤ Cloc. (12.11) The rational positive complex at t = 0 has cohomology only in degree one, of dimension two, so these are specializations of the same determinant.
